rows.en:
Yes, sir…

Toward Earth…!
That's right…
Destroy Big Angel, you say? Easy for a young pup like you to say…

Dr. Sahara has completed the second Brain… no, Big Angel!

That is not a welcome development for us either.

Heh heh heh… Our Space Fortress Naager is already preparing to land on Earth…

And if Big Angel is lost, the Red Muffler Squad's strength will drop as well…

One-Seven will belong to Mister Brain once again, and the Earth will be as good as in our hands…

Hustler! I'll go to the surface and lure out One-Seven!

You destroy Big Angel!
Leave it to me, Mister Brain!
Dr. Sahara, preparations are complete!
All right… Activate Big Angel!!
Doctor…

Yes, it's a success!

Big Angel will start predicting Brain's movements right away…

Y point, minus Z, plus 50… Where is that location?

Yes, sir…

Y point, minus Z, plus 50… That's…!?
What's wrong?
It's near the TDF Far East Base.

What!?

What is Brain plotting?

The Space Fortress Naager has finally started moving toward Earth!

We must stop it from entering the atmosphere, no matter what! Understood?
Leave it to us! We'll show them the Ultra Garrison is here to defend the Earth!
Unfortunately, it won't be that easy.

That's right…

Even the TDF's vaunted long-range missile strike couldn't do any damage at all!
No, no! We mustn't give up…

That's right!

We may have lost Ultraman, but if Zoffy helps us, we've still got three Ultra Brothers! There's no way we'll lose every…
No, the Earth must be protected by our own human hands!
That's right, isn't it, Dan?
All right, Ultra Hawks, sortie!!

…!?

What's that!?
This guy! He means to keep us away from the space fortress!
Doctor! Brain has appeared! Just as Big Angel predicted!

Hmm… Be very careful!

I'm going to have Big Angel calculate a way to destroy Brain completely! Until then, you'd better not attack carelessly.
Understood! First, we'll take down the Brain robots! One-Seveeen!!

One-Seven… Brain will use his super production ability to revive his Brain robots!

Be careful! Let's go! One-Seven!!

That's Haken Killer!?

One-Seven… Brain will use his super production ability to revive his Brain robots!

Be careful! Let's go! One-Seven!!

Director! Brain is interfering with our attack!

It seems he's helping the Space Fortress Naager advance.
What!? Brain is?
So we can't stop the Naager unless we defeat Brain first!?
What about Dr. Sahara? What's the Red Muffler Squad doing?
It seems they're fighting back with One-Seven, but…
Director! Shouldn't we concentrate our forces and meet them again on the ground?
No… We must avoid letting that monstrosity reach the ground at all costs!
Director, I need to speak with you.

…?

What is it?
The truth is, my father served as a TDF staff officer at the time.
Then… as staff officer to the former Director Sawa?

Yes…

I've heard that back then, the TDF and SIDO were at odds over a certain Earth defense plan.
A defense plan?
Project Blue and Project Red.
Project Blue? I've heard rumors about it.

Project Blue was…

an Earth defense barrier that would wrap the Earth and the Moon in a magnetic barrier… It would physically shut out outside enemies. You could call it a plan devoted to the spirit of strict self-defense.

And the planet-attack super weapon R1, which the International Earth Defense Committee decided to cancel on my recommendation…

that is Project Red, the opposite of Project Blue.
So it was named Red after the R in R1?

Yes…

Project Red was the complete opposite of the plan the TDF had proposed, and it was one of the plans SIDO supported.

And there was one more… SIDO drew up a plan to research "Number Ten" and eventually make it function as a forward base for the defense of the solar system.

Hmm… I've read about it in the minutes of the International Earth Defense Committee…

But that means…

we, who tried to develop super weapons not once but twice, are no different from them…

In a sense, perhaps so. But according to my father…

SIDO's true objective was to use "Number Ten" as a home port and develop ultra-long-range spaceships for invading worlds beyond the solar system…

My father said Project Red was a super weapon that was merely the beginning of that.
But why? Why was Project Red carried out over the TDF's objections?
Captain Sawa…
I didn't mean to eavesdrop, but…

It's all right…

I was planning to talk to you sooner or later anyway.

More importantly, do you know the reason?
There was a traitor in the TDF.
A traitor?
Yes… And a person who could put pressure on the International Earth Defense Committee, at that.
You can't mean…!?
It was the former Director of the TDF… my father.
So this is Big Angel?
Right on time, Professor Hustler…
What's this, Doctor Sahara… I've shown up, so why aren't you surprised!?

The answer is simple…

Before you appeared, Big Angel predicted everything for me…

As expected of Big Angel! No wonder Mister Brain fears it…

But now that I'm here… poof! This monstrosity vanishes from the face of the Earth!
It's no use, Professor Hustler… No one can lay a finger on Big Angel!
Hah hah hah! With this Brain program, Big Angel will belong to Brain too!
Wait! Professor Hustler! Big Angel will destroy your cells! Stop it! Hustlerrr!!

"Mister Brain… you really will protect me, right?

If it's like Doctor Sahara says, that's no joke!"
So this is the end of Professor Hustler…
You tricked me!? Brain, you bastard! Waaah…! That's not fair!!

Big Angel will most likely read my strategy…

But that's fine!

This is a battle between Brain and Big Angel… in other words, computer versus computer! Beyond human comprehension…

Big Angel will have produced its answer again… But… I can understand that answer too.

Ah!

Brain went underground!
Then… Steel Emperor Zephas is carrying out the plan from 15 years ago, but from the opposite side?
Using the now-lost "Number Ten" as a forward base to invade this Earth?

I believe that's what it comes to.

Self-defense measures to protect national interests are, from a different point of view, only a hair's breadth from invasion and conquest.

My father's personal theory of strict self-defense was that to counter invaders, you must possess equal offensive power.

And deep down… my father wanted to colonize "Number Ten" and extend his power beyond the solar system.

Then… the incident 15 years ago was a decision of the International Earth Defense Committee passed unanimously?

So the TDF, far from merely the stain of failing to rescue the missing space fortress and leaving its crew to die, actually backed the plan? Is that what you're saying?

It was also on my father's orders that the search for the Space Fortress Naager, which suddenly went missing, was called off!

Apparently there had been talk even before then of SIDO merging with the TDF.

In other words, my father… meant to use SIDO's organizational nature to extend his power beyond the solar system.

It was a plan for the Earth itself to become the greatest invader in the whole universe.

uncertain: U14664: 第2ブレイン rendered 'the second Brain' (Big Angel as a rival computer).
U14666: Brain addresses Hustler as 君 ('Hustler!').
U14681: Furuhashi is cut off ('lose every…'); 全敗 (total defeat) left unfinished.
U14707/U14738: 専守防衛 rendered 'strict self-defense'.
U14708: speaker is Chief of Staff Takenaka per the tag, but the line continues Kitakura's explanation; translated as tagged. R1号 rendered 'super weapon R1'.
U14710: TDFの握事した計画 read as 提示/提唱 ('the plan the TDF had proposed'); 立事 read as 立案 ('drew up').
U14710-U14738: ［ナンバーテン］ brackets changed to quotes; 'Number Ten'.
